_comment: Warnings the very deep check's WARNINGS section has decided to stop showing, each with its reason (practice: very-deep-check; tool: tools/warning_review.py). One entry excludes one group: `source` (doc_lint, precedent_check, or a line source the tool names), `kind` (doc_lint's class, the check's slug, or the line source's own kind: WARNING, or undetermined for the session check), optional `path` (a glob over the file; absent means every file) optional `match` (a substring of the warning text) and optional `status_in` (the file's own frontmatter `status:` must be one of these, so a directory's finished files are excluded and its live ones are not). `term` is permanent, or temporary with a `revisit` date after which the warning shows again. `decided` is the date; `by` is `agent` when the session judged it alone, or the person's name with a `strength` of decided or assented when it asked. An entry that matches nothing any more is reported stale and deleted, never kept.

exclusions.why: A dated record: it says what was true when it was written, and the paths it names in backticks are named as they were.
